description: This file contains a Java interface named EcuDataConvertor that declares methods for converting byte arrays to double values, formatting these values, and retrieving related metadata. It's part of the com.romraider.logger.ecu.definition package, indicating its role in ECU data processing within the RomRaider project.

classes.name: EcuDataConvertor
classes.description: An interface defining methods for converting raw ECU data bytes into meaningful values and retrieving metadata related to these conversions.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a byte array representing ECU data into a double value.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a double value into a string representation.

methods.name: getUnits
methods.description: Returns the measurement units associated with the converted data.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Returns the format string used for data presentation.

methods.name: getExpression
methods.description: Returns the expression used for data conversion or calculation.

methods.name: getDataType
methods.description: Returns the data type information for the ECU data.
